title: Decoder remains auto-regressive, generation not fully parallelized
description: The Transformer's decoder generates outputs one element at a time in an auto-regressive manner, which means generation is not fully parallelized despite the parallelizable encoder.
canonical_description: decoder generates outputs auto-regressively one element at a time, preventing full parallelization of generation
